normative_extracts.spec_section: HTML Living Standard — DOM & Rendering Integration
normative_extracts.quote: Element geometry APIs such as getBoundingClientRect() and offsetWidth require an active layout box generated by CSS box generation and layout.
jsdom does not have the capability to render visual content, and will return zeros for layout-dependent properties like offsetTop and getBoundingClientRect().

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Simulated DOMs stop after phase 1 in Node.js and return static stubs for layout, whereas real browser engines execute phases 2 through 4 to compute geometry, hit-testing, and origin security.

production_failures.symptom: Checkout submit button is unclickable in production despite 100% passing component tests
production_failures.root_cause: A sticky header with z-index: 40 occluded the button on 768px viewports, while JSDOM dispatched click() directly to the DOM node without hit-testing.
production_failures.mitigation: Run pointer-interaction and overlay tests in a real browser engine using Playwright or Vitest Browser Mode.

production_failures.symptom: Authenticated API calls fail with CORS preflight errors in staging after passing all JSDOM tests
production_failures.root_cause: Node-based fetch polyfills and MSW in Node mode do not enforce browser preflight OPTIONS checks or SameSite cookie restrictions.
production_failures.mitigation: Verify cross-origin credentialed requests against a real browser engine with actual HTTP headers.
